# Refined Final Impact Set

Based on the evidence, the entities that must be modified or created are:

- `org.apache.ivy.util.XMLHelper.toSystemId(java.net.URL)` — must be created (called by the seed change; core of the fix)
- `org.apache.ivy.util.XMLHelper.parseToDom(org.xml.sax.InputSource,org.xml.sax.EntityResolver)` — must be created (new overload invoked by the seed change)

## Rationale for removals from the initial static impact set

- `PomModuleDescriptorParser.parseDescriptor(...)` — seed-adjacent call site; constructor signature unchanged, no modification required.
- `PomReader.1.1()` — anonymous `EntityResolver` body untouched by the diff.
- `PomReader.AddDTDFilterInputStream.AddDTDFilterInputStream(...)` — not referenced by changed lines.
- `PomReader.MODEL`, `PomReader.PARENT`, `PomReader.PROJECT` — unrelated constants.
- `PomReader.getFirstChildElement(...)`, `PomReader.parentElement`, `PomReader.projectElement` — DOM traversal/fields unaffected by the parsing-source change.
- `Resource.getName()` — no longer used on this path; not modified.
- `XMLHelper.getDocBuilder(...)` — unchanged; still used by the new overload.
- `URLHandler.openStream(...)`, `URLHandlerRegistry.getDefault()` — stream opening is unaffected; the bug is in parsing, not fetching.

## Rationale for the seed entity removal

- `PomReader.PomReader(java.net.URL,org.apache.ivy.plugins.repository.Resource)` is a seed change and is excluded per instructions.

## Note on `XMLHelper` class-level

The class-level `org.apache.ivy.util.XMLHelper` is not listed separately because the concrete modification targets are the two method-level entities above; listing the class would be redundant with those method entries.
